description: This file defines the TvInstructionsActivity class, a user interface activity for a TV app that displays instructions via a WebView and provides navigation options like acknowledge and back to index. It handles button focus, key events, web view configuration, and navigation intents.

classes.name: TvInstructionsActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays instruction content in a WebView and manages navigation buttons for acknowledgment and returning to index. Implements focus and key event handling for TV remote control.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, configures views, buttons, WebView, and focus.

methods.name: prepareTvWebView
methods.description: Configures the WebView settings for optimal display and interaction on TV.

methods.name: continueToNext
methods.description: Handles the action of acknowledging instructions and navigating to the main index activity.

methods.name: returnToIndex
methods.description: Handles the action of returning to the main index activity.
